mcqs.keyword: High Court appointments and women judges
mcqs.question:
With reference to the judiciary in India as reported in June 2026, consider the following statements:
1. High Court Chief Justices are appointed by the President under Article 217.
2. Women constituted 116 of the 781 High Court judges, amounting to 14.85% in February 2026.
3. In 2018, all four women heading High Courts were full-time Chief Justices.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: High Court Chief Justices are appointed by the President under Article 217, and women numbered 116 of 781 High Court judges, or 14.85%, in February 2026. Statement 3 is incorrect because, in 2018, one of the four women heading High Courts was an acting Chief Justice.
